name: message-broker-selection
description: Select a message broker (Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ / NATS / AWS SQS+SNS / Google Pub/Sub / Azure Service Bus / Redis Streams / Apache Pulsar / AWS Kinesis) based on throughput, ordering, durability, delivery guarantees, replay, fan-out, operational model, cost. Per broker: strengths / weaknesses / delivery semantics / ordering guarantees / operational burden. Recommendation with trade-offs and escape hatch. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
